route_title: Quarter-wave initialized 16-layer stack at LWIR center wavelength
compilation_rationale: Compiles a fixed 16-layer ZnSe/ZnS stack on germanium, initialized near quarter-wave optical thickness at 9500 nm. Optimizes all layer thicknesses within 200–3000 nm bounds to simultaneously maximize short-wave infrared transmittance and suppress mid-wave transmittance using gradient descent with multi-start seeding. Default uncertainty policy applied due to unspecified manufacturing tolerances.
